Russian Railways is, or has been, involved in supporting the Government of Russia as an entity that is carrying on business in the transport sector - a sector of strategic importance to the Government of Russia. By enabling the movement of the Russian Army, combat vehicles and weapons towards the Russian borders with Ukraine, Russian railways is, or has been, providing support for action which destabilises Ukraine or undermines or threatens the territorial integrity, sovereignty or independence of Ukraine. The trust services sanctions were imposed on 21/03/2023. The Director Disqualification Sanction was imposed on 09/04/2025.
